picks.reasoning: Stats are noise; T1 has the one player who takes games over by himself, and they just beat CFO and MKOI. Everyone is hyped on GEN, so I fade them.
Early game is everything, and BLG's +1.1k gold lead at 15 is the best tempo in the field: first drake, first herald, map locked before minute 15.
Fearless punishes one-trick comfort, and DK keeps finding answers: they beat G2 and T1 here and sit 6-1 against other regions. Deep pools, flexible drafts, and that's my pick.
GEN tops the board on game win rate (92-33), has the best record against other regions at 7-1, and is nearly perfect in form, so I'll lean on them, though not too hard.
T1's regular season was a rollercoaster, but this room goes quiet and steady when it gets tense, and three Worlds wins already show it. I'll back that over the numbers.
